Expect more scrutiny, oversight, and restructuring (♄) around Neptunian industries (♆) like oil, gas, chemicals, pharma, maritime/naval operations, and the systems that regulate them.

Previously, when Mars hit Neptune and Saturn in close succession in Feb-Mar, 1990, we saw notable events with these themes:

🧯 Industrial Fires & Chemical Incidents
- The Hagersville Tire Fire (Feb 12 - early Mar 1990): A massive, 17-day arson incident near Hagersville, Ontario, Canada destroying 14 million tires and causing significant environmental damage. - The Perrier Benzene Recall (mid-Feb 1990): One of the most famous "chemical" scares in consumer history: 160M bottles recalled worldwide after benzene (a carcinogen) traces were found. (https://t.co/ZTX8laERBo)

- Bohol Earthquake + local tsunami (Feb 8, 1990): Offshore quake with tsunami impacts struck along Bohol Island in the central Philippines causing bridge collapse, coastal damage, and infrastructure disruption in shoreline communities. (https://t.co/d25YSyJaGB)

- Upland Earthquake, California (Feb 28, 1990): Strong regional quake resulted in structural damage and outages. (https://t.co/uVhzodJmHJ)

🛢️🚢 Oil & Maritime
- American Trader Oil Spill (Feb 7, 1990): Tanker punctured by its own anchor; ~416,598 gallons released offshore Huntington Beach, triggering major wildlife and shoreline impacts. (https://t.co/fVy83QohUF)

- Exxon Valdez legal escalation (Feb 27, 1990): First major criminal charges were brought up for the catastrophic environmental disaster that occurred when Exxon Valdez, an oil supertanker, struck Prince William Sound's Bligh Reef in Alaska on March 24, 1989. In Feb 1990, Federal grand jury issued indictments reflecting stronger demand for criminal accountability + regulatory pressure (♄) for major spills (♆). (https://t.co/H3nDXnD5qw)

- USS Iowa probe reached critical stage (Feb-Mar 1990): After the Apr 19, 1989 Turret Two explosion that killed 47 sailors, the Navy was under intense scrutiny from Congress, the GAO, and internal oversight bodies. The investigation pushed for a fleet-wide safety reset focused on propellant (“powder bag”) handling, gunnery procedures, and accountability (♄) around catastrophic risk (♂/♆). (https://t.co/KpLyK0q5Zt)
